summary.text: The story follows the planeswalker Garruk Wildspeaker, whose spark ignites and sends him to Shandalar, where he hunts the Ursoth and rages at Liliana Vess for killing one of his beasts.
Liliana uses the Chain Veil to overpower and curse Garruk, and he seeks a cure on Ravnica, where he overpowers Jace before coming to his senses and learning Liliana's last location.
Meanwhile on Zendikar the Eldrazi arise once more, and the merfolk realize they had mistaken the Eldrazi names for the legends of gods.
